standard_prerequisites.name: Elementary finite set combinatorics and partial orders
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: All specialized signotope, Ferrers-diagram and component notions are defined in the retained author text.

core_obligations: Characterize one-source co-signotopes through generalized Ferrers diagrams.
Decompose and reconstruct co-signotopes by plus components and sparse compositions.
Construct inverse componentwise bijections across ground-set sizes and prove preservation of the single-step relation.
proof_roadmap: Source-subset structure and one-source Ferrers correspondence
difficulty_reason: The main theorem combines a nontrivial generalized Ferrers-diagram characterization with a reversible plus-component decomposition to transfer co-signotopes between different ground-set sizes. Proving preservation of the Bruhat single-step relation requires the component correspondence; it is not routine counting or an immediate corollary.
